name: Assetto Corsa
description: Assetto Corsa dedicated server (Steam app 302550). The download needs a Steam account that owns Assetto Corsa: set it in Settings > Steam or on the game Steam tab.

customPorts.description: Game (TCP and UDP, server_cfg.ini TCP_PORT and UDP_PORT)
HTTP (TCP, server_cfg.ini HTTP_PORT): lobby info and the status query

editor.label: Listed in the lobby
editor.description: Off: players join through the direct IP only.

editor.label: Pickup mode
editor.description: Players take any free slot of the entry list. Off: booking mode.

editor.label: Loop the sessions
editor.description: Start again with practice after the race.

editor.label: Track
editor.description: The track folder under content/tracks, e.g. magione, monza, spa, ks_nordschleife.

editor.label: Track layout
editor.description: The layout folder of the track, for tracks with several layouts (e.g. layout_gp). Empty for single-layout tracks.

editor.label: Cars
editor.description: Car folders under content/cars, separated by ; (e.g. bmw_m3_e30;abarth500). Every MODEL in cfg/entry_list.ini must be in this list.

editor.label: Allowed tyres
editor.description: Tyre short names separated by ; (e.g. SV;V;H;M;S). Empty allows every tyre of the car.

editor.label: Tyre blankets
editor.description: Tyres start the session at their best temperature.

editor.label: Tyres allowed off track
editor.description: More tyres off track than this is a cut.

editor.label: Client update rate (Hz)
editor.description: Higher is smoother and uses more bandwidth.

editor.label: Hostname
editor.description: Up to 64 characters. Not allowed: line breaks.

editor.label: RCON Password
editor.description: Up to 32 characters. Not allowed: line breaks.

editor.label: Private Password
editor.description: Up to 32 characters. Not allowed: line breaks.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the lobby. One line.

editor.label: Join password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server. One line.

editor.label: Admin password
editor.description: Players who type /admin <password> in the chat get the admin commands (/kick, /ban, /next_session ...). One line.
